title_sq: Shitet apartament 1+1 i perfunduar te rezidenca Kadiu!
description_sq:
Shitet apartament 1+1 i perfunduar, siperfaqe 58.3 m2, kati 6, orientim lindje, tualet me dritare te rezidenca Kadiu. Apartamenti ka nje planimetri te regullt e te mireshfrytezuar. 
Pagese me keste e mundesi financimi deri ne 80% me kolateralin e kompanise.
Apartamenti dorezohet me dyer, dritare, grila, laminat dhe tualet i kompletuar me hidrosanitare inkaso.
title_en: Completed 1+1 apartment for sale in the Kadiu residence!
description_en: Completed 1+1 apartment for sale, surface area 58.3 m2, 6th floor, east orientation, bathroom with window in Kadiu residence. The apartment has a regular and well-used layout. Payment in installments and the possibility of financing up to 80% with the company's collateral. The apartment is delivered with doors, windows, shutters, laminate and a toilet complete with a flush toilet.
